description: OLM LE Dry Carbon Fiber Switch Panel Covers OLM's premium carbon fiber line looks great inside and outside of your vehicle. The trim pieces and style to a relatively dull interior. This piece attaches with the pre-applied 3M double sided adhesive. Simply clean the surface of the factory pieces and attach the new piece. Highlights: This piece is gloss coated to perfection. Expertly crafted in Japan and tested fitting in the US. NOTE: This piece is for the 2017 WRX or 2017 STI. This will not fit 2015, 2016, 2018, etc. We cannot confirm vehicles outside of the US for fitment. Please refer to pictures.
name: OLM LE Dry Carbon Fiber Switch Panel Covers (Version 17) - 2017 Subaru WRX / STI
